title: senecio malvifolius
intro: Senecio malvifolius, commonly known as the Mallow-leaved Flaxleaf, is a plant species within the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Senecio malvifolius are believed to be attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
